title: DeliveryIntelligenceTicketSchema
description: Schema for modeling cross-system ticket telemetry to drive AI-enabled PMO control towers and exception workflows.

ticketId.description: Unique identifier from the tracking system (e.g., Jira).

sourceSystem.description: The origin system feeding data into the control tower.

summary.example: Custom tax calculation bug fix and EDI package routing.

pingPongCount.description: Tracks ticket reassignments back and forth between roles/teams to detect accountability bottlenecks.

slaBreached.description: Flag indicating whether the 24-business-hour response compliance window has been exceeded.

businessHoursElapsed.description: Active business hours spent in the current state without movement.

commercialReconciliationStatus.description: Cross-references Jira engineering tracking against Harvest billable logs to flag revenue leakage.
